title: Publish the Cohort Hackathon & Capstone Evaluation Workspace Blueprint for Technical Academies, by Fri 4 Dec
description:
Almost all software engineering, data science, and product design bootcamps conclude with an intensive 1–2 week capstone hackathon. Instructors currently struggle to coordinate team judging, mentor check-in calls, and code review feedback across fragmented tools. This blueprint establishes Zedu as the turnkey operating system for sprint-based project weeks. No other goal covers hackathons, project-week competitions, or multi-team jury evaluation.

Work under this goal:
- Build the multi-team capstone workspace architecture: private squad channels (#team-alpha, #team-beta), shared mentor support (#mentor-sos), and instructor broadcasts.
- Write the 48-hour hackathon mentor check-in protocol using native Zedu Buzz calls for rapid 15-minute scheduled debugging sessions.
- Design the capstone project submission and code review guidelines utilizing Zedu's 440px discussion thread drawer.
- Draft the private jury deliberation and scoring playbook for inviting guest evaluators to a closed channel with rubrics shared via File Management.

Done when: A comprehensive operations kit is delivered with exact channel permission steps, mentor office-hour agendas, submission templates, and jury scorecard templates. All workflows verified against production zedu.chat features.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Check each hackathon step against controls the app has today, and flag the gaps before writing the kit
acceptedWorkstreams.description: The goal requires every workflow verified against production. From the production code (Cybertron-HNG/zedu-fe, cybertron-integration, 22 Oct 2026): private channels exist (channel management filters by is_private), and threads open in a 440px side drawer. But I found no way to schedule a Buzz call and no AI call summary in the app; the summary is only claimed on the /products/buzz page. So the kit should run mentor check-ins as calendar invites plus 'Start a buzz' in the team channel with a pinned notes template, and list scheduling and summaries as gaps for the product team, not as steps. Tasks: control-by-control map with file references and a gap list (research), then the operations kit with channel setup steps, mentor agendas, submission and jury templates built only on the mapped controls (content).

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Run one real 48-hour trial hackathon in a demo workspace, then write the kit from it
acceptedWorkstreams.description: A blueprint checked against controls can still miss how the week actually flows. Approach: run one full 48-hour mini-cycle in a demo Zedu workspace (team channels, pinned standup format, mentor Buzz check-ins, submission threads) with the team's participation, record every screen and where it went wrong, then write the hand-off kit from the run. Gaps the app can't support go into a flagged list at the end, exactly as the accepted approach requires. Tasks: trial run with screenshots (research), the write-up (content).
